correctness.rationale: The final claim is finite and exhaustively reconstructed from the q-ary descendant definition. The verifier builds all 972 forbidden triples on 27 words, exhaustively finds no valid 10-set and exactly 12 valid 9-sets, checks all 12 directly, proves their pair projections are bijections, independently enumerates exactly 12 Latin squares of order 3 and matches their graphs to the complete census, and exhausts all 1296 natural isometries to obtain one orbit and stabilizer 108. The search invariant is hereditary forbidden-triple avoidance, so the finite enumeration is exhaustive rather than sampled. No claim beyond the finite parameter is inferred.

value.rationale: This is a natural equality classification at the first nonbinary parameter where the classical three-row frameproof bound is sharp, not an arbitrary slice. It identifies all extremizers of the known q^2 bound at q=3 with the canonical Latin-square objects, gives the exact labeled multiplicity, and shows there is only one natural equivalence type. Equality rigidity and orbit data sharpen a standard extremal existence result and are reusable when comparing small separating-hash/frameproof constructions.
